_about: Public-domain William Bates (1625-1699, Presbyterian divine ejected in 1662, called 'silver-tongued') for the Word Hoard: the Whole Works (London: Black, 1815, 4 vols), vols 2-4 from Google scans, with three of his books printed separately standing in for the missing vol. 1: The Harmony of the Divine Attributes (New York, 1831), The Four Last Things (London: Seeley, 1826) and Spiritual Perfection (London: Hatchard, 1834). Raw Internet Archive OCR. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 7 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

wbates-works-2: The Whole Works of the Rev. W. Bates, vol. 2 (London: Black, 1815)

wbates-spiritual-perfection-1834: Spiritual Perfection Unfolded and Enforced from 2 Cor. vii. 1 (London: Hatchard, 1834)
